subject: Re: Redwood + NovaSoft: Co-branded 'Inference in Production' Hands-on Workshop
messages:
From: Priya Desai <priya@novasoft.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: events@novasoft.com
Date: 2026-12-01T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: NovaSoft x Redwood: Workshop proposal & dates

Hi Marissa / Jonas,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — our developer programs team is excited to run a joint, hands-on workshop focused on "Inference in Production" for engineering audiences. High-level idea: a 90-minute virtual session (30m talk + 60m guided lab) where NovaSoft and Redwood jointly demo a small inference pipeline, show best practices for latency and cost, and let participants run a short lab using a guided notebook.

Proposed dates: Thu Dec 10 (preferred) or Tue Dec 15.
Audience target: 50-75 developers (mix of PLG sign-ups and invited customers).

I've attached an initial agenda (workshop-agenda-v3.pdf) and a stub for co-branding assets. Questions we have for you:
- Can Redwood provide a short, pre-provisioned cloud sandbox or demo VM for ~50 concurrent learners?
- Any constraints on the runtime or models we should pick?
- Will Redwood provide a short 15-min product intro + 30m lab lead?

If dec 10 works we can lock promo and send a Save The Date by EOD Monday.

Best,
Priya Desai
Head of Developer Programs
NovaSoft

Attachment: workshop-agenda-v3.pdf (application/pdf)
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T16:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NovaSoft x Redwood: Workshop proposal & dates

Hi Priya — great to see this moving forward. Dec 10 works for us today; we can also hold Dec 15 as a backup. Quick notes/asks from our side:

Objectives (what we'll measure):
- 50% of attendees complete the lab flow (guided notebook + run inference).
- We capture feedback on two prompts: latency sensitivity and cost tradeoffs.
- Collect 1–2 mutual case studies / quotes for post-event follow-up.

Logistics/questions:
- We can provision a sandbox for up to 60 concurrent learners. We typically run these on a shared cloud cluster with a soft cap — can you confirm whether NovaSoft will accept our hosted sandbox or prefer we provide IaC for your cloud?
- For the demo model, recommend a small open decoder (1–4B) to keep token costs and latency reasonable. Any objections?
- We'll prepare a 15-min product overview + 30-min lab lead. Can you allocate a NovaSoft presenter for the opening 10 minutes on how customers use NovaSoft's tooling with Redwood?

Branding: attaching our co-branding guidelines (co-branding-guidelines.png). Please send two logos (SVG & 300x300 PNG) and exact copy for the registration page.

Next steps:
1) Confirm date (Dec 10 or 15) — Priya
2) Provide logos + copy — NovaSoft
3) We’ll send a draft event page and the lab access plan by Tue Dec 8 — Marissa

Thanks!
Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: co-branding-guidelines.png (image/png)
